headline: Russia hits power stations in Kyiv and Zhytomyr regions on Wednesday, plus a cargo vessel near Odesa, continuing the grid campaign
dek: Russia's defence ministry said it hit two power stations in Ukraine's Kyiv and Zhytomyr regions on Wednesday, keeping up near-daily strikes on energy facilities as temperatures fall; the strikes also targeted a cargo vessel at sea near Odesa. Ukraine's emergency service and local officials…
sources: Reuters Nov 4; Russian defence ministry statement on Telegram; Ukraine emergency service and local officials via Telegram
fault_line: Grid war on the eve of Brussels talks: pressure tactic to force concessions, or a talks-killer before Abu Dhabi?

sections.what_happened: Russia's defence ministry said it hit two power stations in Ukraine's Kyiv and Zhytomyr regions on Wednesday, keeping up near-daily strikes on energy facilities as temperatures fall; the strikes also targeted a cargo vessel at sea near Odesa. Ukraine's emergency service and local officials reported strikes also in Poltava, Dnipro, Kirovohrad and Rivne regions. This follows Tuesday's bombardment (289 drones, 17 ballistic, 59 cruise missiles; DTEK 3 of 5 thermal plants offline — recorded 0900-05). Separately, a drone attack near Krasnodar set fire to an Ozon logistics hub (already recorded 0700-04), and Russia-held Crimea ordered power cuts after an accident outside the region, cause unclear.
sections.what_verified: Reuters (T1 wire) carries both the Russian ministry claim and Ukrainian official reports; the two sides corroborate that strikes occurred Wednesday, but specific targets/damage are single-side claims. Ozon warehouse fire already independently recorded (company statement, 0700-04).
sections.what_disputed: Target selection and damage are asserted by the Russian ministry (attacker claim) and only partially matched by Ukrainian reports, which list different/additional regions; no independent damage assessment or casualty figure in the Reuters relay. Crimea power-cut cause explicitly unclear.
sections.why_matters: Monitor only — second consecutive day of grid strikes, but no new toll, no named plant destroyed and no outcome yet; shippable only with a verified casualty/capacity number or a Brussels outcome.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP (Reuters, Nov 4, updated ~11:00 ; absent from 1200/1300/1400 scans): Russia hits power stations in Kyiv and Zhytomyr regions on Wednesday, plus a cargo vessel near Odesa, continuing the grid campaign

totw_analysis: Our read: Monitor only — second consecutive day of grid strikes, but no new toll, no named plant destroyed and no outcome yet; shippable only with a verified casualty/capacity number or a Brussels outcome. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Grid war on the eve of Brussels talks: pressure tactic to force concessions, or a talks-killer before Abu Dhabi?
